description: Expected personal-data regions on the specimen images of manifest.json, keyed by image SHA-256. Boxes only, never values (ADR 0005).
box_format: [x1, y1, x2, y2] as fractions of the image width and height (after EXIF orientation)
method: Drawn by hand on a 5% grid overlay while reviewing each image; SAM was not used to propose boxes, so the labels are independent of the system under test. Boxes are approximate (about +/-1-2% of the image side).

region_types.portrait: a clearly visible face photo: the main portrait and clear secondary/ghost portraits (faint laser ghosts are not labelled)
region_types.text: one personal-data value: name, birth name, parents' names, date or place of birth, address, document/personal/card-access number. Field captions, nationality, sex, height and issue/expiry dates are not labelled
